notes: Nahrávanie bicích z klávesnice, MIDI kláves aj klikom na pady funguje. ● zapne aj reproduktor stopy, MIDI hrá len stopy so zapnutým reproduktorom (alebo vybranú). Inspiria: citlivosť kláves – ikona klávesnice vedľa ♪.
notes_en: Recording drums from the computer keyboard, MIDI keys and by clicking pads works. ● also turns on the track speaker; MIDI plays only tracks with the speaker on (or the selected one). Inspiria: key sensitivity – keyboard icon next to ♪.
